# vastdata_callhome_config (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_callhome_config" "vastdb_callhome_config" {
  id         = 1
  obfuscated = true
}

# ---------------------
# Complete examples
# ---------------------

# e2e: adopt Call Home config id=1 and set a non-secret field.
resource "vastdata_callhome_config" "vastdb_callhome_config" {
  id         = 1
  obfuscated = true
}

# --------------------

# e2e: proxy settings including write-only proxy_password (MD5 change detection).
resource "vastdata_callhome_config" "vastdb_callhome_config" {
  id             = 1
  proxy_host     = "proxy.e2e.local"
  proxy_port     = "3128"
  proxy_username = "e2e-proxy-user"
  proxy_password = "e2e-proxy-pw-A"
}

# --------------------
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the Call Home configuration (typically 1).

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `aggregated` (Boolean) If true, send aggregated callhome logs, otherwise upload logs from each node
- `alt_s3_host_port` (String) Specifies alternative S3 service host and port for upload. For example: 10.10.10.10:443.
- `aws_s3_ak` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) S3 Bucket access key
- `aws_s3_bucket_name` (String) S3 Bucket for upload
- `aws_s3_bucket_subdir` (String) Sub-Directory in support bucket
- `aws_s3_sk` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) S3 Bucket secret key
- `bundle_enabled` (Boolean) Set to true to enable periodic sending of bundles to the Support server (deprecated)
- `bundle_interval` (Number) The frequency for sending bundles to the Support server (deprecated)
- `cloud_api_domain` (String) Uplink API domain name
- `cloud_api_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Uplink API key
- `cloud_enabled` (Boolean) Set to true to enable reporting to Uplink, VAST's cloud-based SaaS that enables you to manage all VAST Clusters deployed by your organization anywhere in the world through a single cloud portal.
- `cloud_subdomain` (String) Uplink subdomain, unique per customer and shared by all clusters reporting to the customer's Uplink.
- `compress_method` (String) Compression method for callhome bundles (by default zstd)
- `customer` (String) Company name
- `customer_id` (String) The ID issued to the customer
- `location` (String) Site location
- `log_enabled` (Boolean) Set to true to enable system state data to be logged to the Support server
- `log_interval` (Number) The frequency for sending system state data to the Support server.
- `luna_analyze_period` (Number) Analyzed period size, minutes
- `luna_on_alarm_enabled` (Boolean) Enabled/disabled luna analyzing tool on specific alarms
- `luna_on_alarm_interval` (Number) Maximum allowed frequency in hours for alarm-triggered luna
- `max_upload_bandwidth` (Number) The maximum upload bandwidth in bytes.
- `max_upload_concurrency` (Number) The maximum number of parts of a file to upload simultaneously.
- `obfuscated` (Boolean) If true, call home data is obfuscated.
- `proxy_host` (String) Proxy IP/hostname
- `proxy_password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Proxy password
- `proxy_port` (String) Proxy Port
- `proxy_scheme` (String)
- `proxy_username` (String) Proxy username
- `site` (String) Site name
- `support_channel` (Boolean) Set to true to enable the VAST Support channel.
- `test_mode` (Boolean) Set to true to enable test mode
- `uplink_email` (String) VAST Uplink super user login email.
- `uplink_password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) VAST Uplink super user password.
- `uplink_token` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) VAST Uplink cluster registration token.
- `upload_via_vms` (Boolean) If true, upload non-aggregated Callhome Bundle via VMS (requires proxy). Otherwise, upload from each node.
- `verify_ssl` (Boolean) Set to true to enable SSL verification. Set to false to disable. VAST Cluster recognizes SSL certificates from a large range of widely recognized certificate authorities (CAs). VAST Cluster may not recognize an SSL certificate signed by your own in-house CA.

### Read-Only

- `aws_s3_ak_md5` (String) MD5 of aws_s3_ak (lowercase hex). Computed from the configured value at plan time so changes to the write-only field are detected. Not settable.
- `aws_s3_sk_md5` (String) MD5 of aws_s3_sk (lowercase hex). Computed from the configured value at plan time so changes to the write-only field are detected. Not settable.
- `callhome_upload_destination` (String) Callhome upload destination.
- `cloud_api_key_md5` (String) MD5 of cloud_api_key (lowercase hex). Computed from the configured value at plan time so changes to the write-only field are detected. Not settable.
- `cloud_registered` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is registered with VAST Cloud Services / Uplink.
- `proxy_password_md5` (String) MD5 of proxy_password (lowercase hex). Computed from the configured value at plan time so changes to the write-only field are detected. Not settable.
- `ssl_certificate` (String) SSL Certificate file content, including the BEGIN CERTIFICATE and END CERTIFICATE lines.
- `uplink_password_md5` (String) MD5 of uplink_password (lowercase hex). Computed from the configured value at plan time so changes to the write-only field are detected. Not settable.
- `uplink_token_md5` (String) MD5 of uplink_token (lowercase hex). Computed from the configured value at plan time so changes to the write-only field are detected. Not settable.
